items.title: Mike Vax interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2022
items.q: I mean you take the complete opposite ends, say Chet Baker and Maynard Ferguson. But if you heard Maynard play a ballad, or you heard Maynard play a jazz solo that was just amazing, you know that recording of Maynard and Clifford Brown and Clark Terry with Dinah Washington.

ctx.x: You didn’t have all that juice in there to play through. Wow. There’s a quote here, someone saying, I think they’re saying that you said this. It was in amongst the things you sent me. “Mike Vax reminded us all that being a great musician is far more important than being a great trumpeter. He exemplifies this concept with every fiber of his being.”

That was from, this is quite a while now, the first Westchester Trumpet Festival which was a big one. And I was the featured artist. It was an interesting thing because I had had throat surgery I think three weeks before and they didn’t cut me, they went through, but I had nodes on my vocal cords. I was starting to sound like Miles, man. You know and I couldn’t talk very loud. And so for two weeks I couldn’t talk and I couldn’t play. So I had a week and I just got myself back together as much as I could and I…
